Run a rule now over the whole cache, oldest first, up to its cap

## Usage

```text
chainmail rule run <id|name> [--max N] [--account NAME] [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
# work through a backlog 100 messages at a time
chainmail rule run inbox-cleanup --max 100
```

## Flags

```text
      --account string   only this account (default: every account the rule covers)
      --max int32        act on at most this many messages per account, 1 to 5000 (default: the rule's max_per_run)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
